Single nucleotide variant repeat data

data_snv.Rd

Single nucleotide variant repeat data

Usage

data_snv

Format

A dataframe in tidy format with columns for sample, replicate, variant and variant frequency. This dataset includes different numbers of variants per sample, and different numbers of replicates per sample. Some variants are different and some are shared between samples.

Source

Frequency results are randomly generated with R.The code for generating the data is saved in the data-raw folder.

Examples

data_snv
#>      sample replicate         variant frequency
